wave1 is the easiest but final boss deals huge damage, so you should use your best dps and c:lotan seems to be your fave! 
wave 2 is icefield so caraboo is very helpful and counter
wave 3 is only one boss fight, so ultra is very beneficial here
wave 4 has a huge shield and does sacrifice, so dps gmurphy works great, otherwise ghelot helps a lot!
wave 5 has many complicated mechanics; icefield, favors healing and does huge damage. if you don't use the arachne support build (where you can put your lv1 chaos characters on), i'd highly recommend celeste, caraboo (if not used for wave 2), caecus with his rouse activated for slow but steady counter damage with lots of healing or votice to make use of her pursuit, the newest wod featuring doll is very effective here too!

Hello! Forgive me I'm not an "expert" but I am a mostly f2p endgame player that doesn't use limited overexalts and prioritizes fun over meta, so I'll try to help the best I can until a better player comes along!

First I want to ask what's your player level and do you have any favorite characters? Most characters are viable for normal and just need to be carefully built around (while keeping chapter stages in mind!)

That said judging by the heart on Horla, lv62 Arachne, lv62 Saya, e3 c:Lotan and e12 Caecus, I'm gonna assume those are your faves? (Great picks btw!!)

Horla + Arachne is a very strong combo, as long as you avoid using insight cards when there's "call" enemies present (they're the ones holding a telephone and gain shield + strength if you play a non-command card), final verdict has decent damage potential and a well-timed ultra round can defeat most/all enemies in one turn, without worrying about the shields! 
(plus I *highly recommend* giving Horla 1 enlighten so you get "vulnerable" and "weakness" it's very powerful and will help survive tough enemies!)

Caraboo + Saya + Faint will be a great combo too, p-caro has survival issues but Faint's death res will save you, it wouldn't be a bad idea to add in Caecus for counter damage, shields from tentacles and his rouse healing! 

(part 1/2 due to discord limit)
thread_title: Help with some directions and maybe goals?

content:
I don't like giving pull advice as that takes out the joy and it highly varies player to player! But I will say that every "chapter character" gains a massive advantage for their own chapter (Arc 2=Clem, Arc 3=Dorsain, Arc 4=G:Murphy, Arc 5=Arachne, Arc 6=Caraboo) so it might be wise to get at least an e0. (But again, your current roster should be very capable of taking on all arc 2 normal until chapter 5-6 without gnosis, or at most 2!) 

On that note, I will also suggest/ask **if you have upgraded "soulforge"**? Your Horla is 0/0/5 which suggests she's at 0 soulforge and doesn't have it activated!! You're playing at a *massive disadvantage* in arc 2 or any astral stages if it's not upgraded or at least activated, as it boosts every character's stats and even gives them realm or chapter-specific buffs! 

However I will emphasize Faint again as her bonus death res acts as a "free" gnosis, but death res in general is vital, if you've hit a wall. 

(also sorry, I know you said you don't want advice on "just team building" but your current roster is *perfectly fine*! Feel free to also share your WoDs if you'd like me to put together a lineup or two for chapter 2+3, but no worries if not and you'd like to figure that out yourself!) 

Good luck and sorry this got quite long!!

(part 2/2)
